name: DataCraft
tagline: Find your way through the data.

employee.instructions: Use DataCraft only with databases and connection scope explicitly authorized for this task. Start with read-only access. Never discover, reuse or expose the Studio service-role key, another task credential or unrelated connected accounts. Database writes and schema changes require the creator's explicit scope and a reviewable query. Preserve editable SQL and identified result snapshots; never embed connection passwords in library packages. The native database workspace has no verified browser/library adapter yet. Work only in the assigned project and task working folder. Use studio-mcp for authorized library access. Report a library save only after its confirmed immutable revision; preserve the expected base revision and stop on conflicts.
